root_cause.text: The `sof_compr_pointer` function divides by `sstream->channels * sstream->sample_container_bytes` without validating that these fields have been configured (they default to 0), allowing a divide-by-zero when the stream is not yet set up.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (!sstream->channels || !sstream->sample_container_bytes) return -EBUSY;` before the division operation `div_u64(spcm->stream[cstream->direction].posn.dai_posn, ...)`; the commit message explicitly states that these values default to 0 and are only configured as part of setting stream parameters, enabling a divide by zero.
